lines.text: Hezekiah son of Ahaz became king of Judah at twenty-five and reigned in Jerusalem twenty-nine years.
Hezekiah did what was right like his father David, removing the high places and demolishing the bronze snake Moses made.
Hezekiah trusted the LORD, and no king of Israel was like him, before or after.
Hezekiah defeated the Moabites as far as Gaza and its borders, from watchtower to fortified city.
Shalmaneser besieged Samaria, and after three years the Assyrians captured it and exiled the Israelites to Assyria.
